channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jaden Ivey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jaden Ivey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Jalen Duren on Jaden Ivey:

“It’s tough man. Obviously it’s a business so things happen, but that will be my brother forever. We came in this together, struggled together, we won together, lost together … I tell people he’s my favorite player and still is and forever will be.”

Jalen Duren on Jaden Ivey, Feb 22, 2026. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Jaden Ivey:

“He wasn’t in an easy situation but I think he handled it extremely well … I think a fresh opportunity will be good for himand I know he has his situation with his knee, but I hope he gets right and finishes the season strong.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jaden Ivey, Feb 21, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Jaden Ivey:

“We expected a full recovery but the timing we didn’t know, which is something you can’t ever know. And then the part of it for him, believing it and trusting it. That happens with injury too, especially when you’re that explosive and your athleticism is so unique.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jaden Ivey, Feb 21, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: Cade Cunningham on playing with Jaden Ivey:

“Me and Ivey, bro, we haven’t got a lot of time together. I’ve always felt like we could figure it out and be special.”

Cade Cunningham on Jaden Ivey, Nov 17, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Isaiah Stewart, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Trajan on Jaden Ivey and Isaiah Stewart's injury status:

“I wouldn't say there a full go but they’re coming along. They’ll be ready for camp.”

Trajan Langdon on Isaiah Stewart, Jaden Ivey, Jun 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Snakofa:JB Bickerstaff on why Cade Cunningham and Jaden Ivey have meshed well together:

“They understand each other, and that’s good thing. The time that they’ve spent together, they know each others strengths and weaknesses and they both want to play the right way.”

JB Bickerstaff on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey, Nov 21, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Monty Williams on if, in a perfect world, one of Cade Cunningham or Jaden Ivey is on the floor at all times:

“I think so. I wouldn’t go that far and put that much pressure on two young guys like that. We have to be more team-oriented than that.”

Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham, Jaden Ivey, Mar 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Duren on Ivey:

“It’s hard to explain him, man. He’s a guy who’s super humble, one of the nicest guys I’ve ever met. Genuine. But when he’s on the court he’s a whole different person. A dog, a maniac.”

Jalen Duren on Jaden Ivey, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Williams on Ivey's ceiling:

“It's hard to recognize what a guy's ceiling is, but I see a young man who is getting better and coachable.”

Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Williams on Ivey:

“You look at the offense and see unreal numbers, but I'm really proud of the defense tonight. There were times he was guarding a bigger guy and walled up or made them pass the ball. That's something I think we can see on a consistent basis.”

Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey, Jan 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Williams on Ivey's turn around in second half:

“His accountability -- it wasn't fake. He knew that segment he had put us in a bind. Some guys say 'My bad' just to get it out of the way.”

Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey, Jan 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Monty on Bogey and Cade coaching Ivey from the bench:

“That’s who we are. We’ve had an unreal losing streak this year. I don’t think I’ve seen our guys consistently go in the tank. Our guys are all in every day, not just to win but to see each other do well.”

Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey, Jan 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Killian Hayes, Marcus Sasser, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Monty on expectations for Ivey/Hayes/Sasser:

“I expect our guys to step up & try to win the game. This is not an opportunity to just go out & jack up shots because Cade's not out there & this is X amount of shots to be spread around. I want our guys to play winning basketball.”

Monty Williams on Killian Hayes, Marcus Sasser, Jaden Ivey, Jan 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Monty on Ivey:

“He’s better. He’s had a viral thing going on. It affects people differently. Cade’s been under the weather for about a week and a half and he’s been pushing through it … different guys have had it on the team. (Ivey) was struggling for a while.”

Monty Williams on Jaden Ivey, Nov 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
#Pistons GM Troy Weaver on getting No. 5 pick:

“We landed there last year and we were able to add a young talented player to our core in Jaden Ivey. Landing here at No. 5 again this year, we're ready to add another player to our core.”

Troy Weaver on Jaden Ivey, May 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey on Ivey:

“It's not his fault. He's a rookie. He's going against some of the best vets in the league. They put Grant on him, one of the best defenders... he's pressing a little bit. He's going through growing pains.”

Dwane Casey on Jaden Ivey, Jan 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Rodney McGruder on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
McGruder on what Ivey brings to the #Pistons:

“That speed. That's something you can't teach. You can teach somebody to shoot the ball, to finish and stuff like that but his speed and how unselfish he is, getting in the paint and making the right plays, you can't teach that.”

Rodney McGruder on Jaden Ivey, Oct 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Cade Cunningham on rookie Jaden Ivey:

“He'll make it a lot easier for everybody. He has agreat feel for the game, and he wants to win.”

Cade Cunningham on Jaden Ivey, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Casey on if Cade will figure out how to play with Jaden Ivey:

“He will, because his IQ is off the charts. He has the ability to play off the ball. One thing that impressed me with Jaden’s passing ability was the way he saw the floor. It’ll be something good to see.”

Dwane Casey on Jaden Ivey, Jul 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jalen Duren, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
#PistonsTroy Weaver on the draft:

“We had a list of seven guys that we liked, and (Jaden Ivey and Jalen Duren) were at the top of that list.”

Troy Weaver on Jalen Duren, Jaden Ivey, Jun 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Troy Weaver on Jaden Ivey:

“He has electric speed, and he'll create opportunities for us because of his speed. He has the athletic gifts to become a tremendous defender.”

Troy Weaver on Jaden Ivey, Jun 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.
